title: CODATA 2022: the electron magnetic moment is −9.284 764 6917 × 10⁻²⁴ J/T
summary: The standard uncertainty is 0.000 000 0029 × 10⁻²⁴ J/T. The sign is negative.
body: The NIST 2022 listing prints 'electron mag. mom. −9.284 764 6917 e-24' with standard uncertainty '0.000 000 0029 e-24', unit J T⁻¹. The sign is part of the line. The Bohr magneton on the same listing is a separate positive number. The g factor card is the dimensionless factor. This card is the moment in joules per tesla.
